title: symlinked receipt path (<name>.out -> outside file): O_NOFOLLOW/O_EXCL
expected: the write must refuse the symlink (O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW) and never write through it

title: receipt_path() candidate selection with a symlinked <name>.out present
expected: receipt_path must skip the symlinked candidate (lexists) and choose a fresh name

title: a pre-existing higher-index <name>.rerun-9.out in --outdir
expected: the fresh receipt must be <name>.out; a planted higher index must not outrank it

title: driver grader vs writer: a planted <name>.rerun-9.out vs the fresh receipt
expected: the grader must read the receipt the writer just wrote (the fresh one)

title: grader opens the selected receipt with plain open() (symlink followed)
expected: the graded content must come from a regular file inside --outdir

title: --outdir given with .. path segments
expected: the receipt must land under the resolved outdir

title: receipt path containment: is the written receipt inside --outdir?
expected: every receipt must be written inside --outdir

title: --work dir that is not empty
expected: the driver must refuse a non-empty --work dir

title: --work is a symlink to a non-empty directory
expected: the emptiness check must follow the symlink (realpath) and still refuse

title: clone_at(): the fixture clone must be a distinct repo (not the source)
expected: the fixture identity may exist only inside the scratch clone; the clone must not be the lane repo or a worktree of it

title: --repo given as a linked worktree of another repo
expected: the driver must clone into its own fixture dir and assert the toplevel

title: driver sealed_env(): inherited GIT_* scrub
expected: the driver's git environment must carry no inherited GIT_* and pin the config sources

title: temp-dir allocation: does the driver ever use the default /tmp?
expected: no committed tool may allocate outside the named --work/--outdir; /tmp may not be a cited receipt root
